title: Rumored tunnels and cave system under mesa

tellings.quote: material. It was because there were rumors going back to the the big blow era and even before, going back to the Mayans, that there was a cave system,

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah long known for reports of strange happenings, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that there have long been rumours of tunnels and a cave system under a mesa, a flat-topped hill, on the land. The owner says these rumours go back to an earlier owner's time and, as the story goes, even back to the Mayans. If true, it would mean something hidden lies underground beneath the ranch.
